title.en: Check which security your Wi-Fi uses
title.hinglish: Dekho tumhara Wi-Fi kaunsi security use karta hai

why.en: Shows whether your current connection uses WPA2 or WPA3 (SAE).
why.hinglish: Dikhata hai ki tumhara current connection WPA2 ya WPA3 (SAE) use karta hai.

expect.en: The Authentication line reads WPA3-Personal (or WPA2-Personal on older networks); on Linux the SECURITY column shows WPA3 or WPA2. It depends on your router.
expect.hinglish: Authentication line mein WPA3-Personal (ya purane networks par WPA2-Personal) likha hota hai; Linux par SECURITY column WPA3 ya WPA2 dikhata hai. Yeh tumhare router par depend karta hai.

title.en: See the SAE Commit and Confirm frames
title.hinglish: SAE Commit aur Confirm frames dekho

why.en: In the .pcap, SAE uses authentication frames with algorithm 3.
why.hinglish: .pcap mein SAE algorithm 3 wale authentication frames use karta hai.

expect.en: Four authentication frames: two Commits (sequence 1) and two Confirms (sequence 2), carrying the scalar and element.
expect.hinglish: Chaar authentication frames: do Commits (sequence 1) aur do Confirms (sequence 2), jinme scalar aur element hote hain.

title.en: Compare the RSN element in beacons
title.hinglish: Beacons mein RSN element compare karo

why.en: The AKM suite shows 8 (SAE) for WPA3 and 2 (PSK) for WPA2.
why.hinglish: AKM suite WPA3 ke liye 8 (SAE) aur WPA2 ke liye 2 (PSK) dikhata hai.

expect.en: Expand the RSN information in a Beacon; the downgrade scenario shows both AKM 2 and 8 on the real router and only 2 on the evil twin.
expect.hinglish: Beacon ki RSN information expand karo; downgrade scenario mein asli router par AKM 2 aur 8 dono dikhte hain aur evil twin par sirf 2.

title.en: List nearby networks and their security
title.hinglish: Aas-paas ke networks aur unki security list karo

why.en: A read-only look at which nearby networks advertise WPA3.
why.hinglish: Read-only dekho ki aas-paas ke kaunse networks WPA3 advertise karte hain.

expect.en: Each SSID shows its authentication. Many show WPA2 only; WPA3 or WPA2/WPA3 transition mode entries are the newer ones. Output varies by place.
expect.hinglish: Har SSID apni authentication dikhata hai. Kai sirf WPA2 dikhate hain; WPA3 ya WPA2/WPA3 transition mode wali entries naye hote hain. Output jagah ke hisaab se alag hota hai.
